goal: Replace the original transformations fields and methods in ByteBuddyAndroidTaskExtension with a single delegate field and forwarding methods (facade) to preserve the external API while removing members from the target class.

ops.details: The original private final List<Transformation> transformations field is moved into ByteBuddyAndroidTransformations as a private final List<Transformation> field. The original field is removed from ByteBuddyAndroidTaskExtension and replaced by a private final ByteBuddyAndroidTransformations transformations delegate field.

Move implementation of getTransformations() and both transformation(...) methods into ByteBuddyAndroidTransformations. In ByteBuddyAndroidTaskExtension, replace the moved methods with façade methods delegating to the delegate field: return transformations.getTransformations(); transformations.transformation(...). Initialize the delegate in the ByteBuddyAndroidTaskExtension constructor: this.transformations = new ByteBuddyAndroidTransformations(project);

Keep the original public API surface on ByteBuddyAndroidTaskExtension by providing delegating methods that forward calls to the new ByteBuddyAndroidTransformations instance. This preserves backwards compatibility and reduces the number of fields/methods inside the target class body.
